senses.gloss: f. (an adapt. of fascia, as if from פסק) band or fillet worn by women over the breast; girdle; bandage round the legs and feet.
units: Targ. Is. III, 24 פְּסִיקַיָּא (pl. form).—
Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ bot. נתן את הברזל תחת פ׳ שלו he put the iron point of his spear under his fascia.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 15:2">Sabb. XV, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 111b:8">111ᵇ</cite>) <he>ושל פסי׳</he> (Bab. ed. <cite ref="Q01359"><he>פסקיא</he></cite>) and the cords of the breast bandage.

Ib. (113ᵃ) קושרין דלי בפ׳ וכ׳ (Bab. ed. בפסק׳ you may (on the Sabbath) tie up (the broken rope of) a bucket with a fascia, but not with a rope. Ib. 113ᵃ כורך עליו פונדא או פ׳ (Ms. M. פסיקא) he may wind a funda or a fascia around it; Pes. 11ᵃ פיסקיא (Ms. M. פסיקיא; early ed. פסקי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ פיסקי (corr. acc.), v. עֲגַל I; a. e.—Pl. form פְּסִיקִין.

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:2">Sifré Num. 131</cite> <he>והיא מוציאה … מתחת פ׳ שלה</he> (not <he>פסוקין</he>) she took an impression of Peor from under her breast band (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:11">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>חיקה</he>).
